```{r}

# Load packages
library(tidyverse)

# Read the data
housing <- readRDS("data/housing_clean.rds")

# Keep variables for modeling
# Remove rows with missing prices
housing_model <- housing %>%
  select(Price, Rooms, Type, Distance,
         Bathroom, Car, Landsize, Regionname) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Price)) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = as.factor(Type),
    Regionname = as.factor(Regionname)
  )

# Check the cleaned data
dim(housing_model)
summary(housing_model)
```

```{r}
# Check the distribution of prices
ggplot(housing_model, aes(x = Price)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Housing Prices",
    x = "Price (AUD)",
    y = "Number of Properties"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Compare prices by property type
ggplot(housing_model, aes(x = Type, y = Price)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Housing Prices by Property Type",
    x = "Property Type",
    y = "Price (AUD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Check rooms and price
ggplot(housing_model, aes(x = Rooms, y = Price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, color = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Rooms vs Housing Price",
    x = "Number of Rooms",
    y = "Price (AUD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Check missing values
housing_model %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.))))
```
